scripts.prebuild: cross-env NODE_ENV=development npm run clean && npm run validate:env && npx tsx scripts/syncVersion.ts
scripts.prebuild:qa: cross-env NODE_ENV=qa npm run clean && cross-env NODE_ENV=qa npm run validate:env && npx tsx scripts/syncVersion.ts
scripts.prebuild:prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run clean && cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run validate:env && npx tsx scripts/syncVersion.ts
scripts.dev: env-cmd -f ./.env.development cross-env NODE_ENV=development npm run validate:env && env-cmd -f ./.env.development cross-env NODE_ENV=development concurrently "vite build --watch" "serve -l 3000"
scripts.dev:qa: env-cmd -f ./.env.qa cross-env NODE_ENV=qa npm run validate:env && env-cmd -f ./.env.qa cross-env NODE_ENV=qa concurrently "vite build --watch" "serve -l 3000"
scripts.dev:prod: env-cmd -f ./.env.production cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run validate:env && env-cmd -f ./.env.production cross-env NODE_ENV=production concurrently "vite build --watch" "serve -l 3000"
scripts.serve:dev: env-cmd -f ./.env.development cross-env NODE_ENV=development npm run validate:env && env-cmd -f ./.env.development cross-env NODE_ENV=development concurrently "vite build --watch" "serve dist -l 0.0.0.0:3000 --cors"
scripts.serve:qa: env-cmd -f ./.env.qa cross-env NODE_ENV=qa npm run validate:env && env-cmd -f ./.env.qa cross-env NODE_ENV=qa concurrently "vite build --watch" "serve dist -l 0.0.0.0:3000 --cors"
scripts.serve:prod: env-cmd -f ./.env.production cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run validate:env && env-cmd -f ./.env.production cross-env NODE_ENV=production concurrently "vite build --watch" "serve dist -l 0.0.0.0:3000 --cors"
scripts.serve:dev:https: npm run _check:https && env-cmd -f ./.env.development cross-env NODE_ENV=development npm run validate:env && env-cmd -f ./.env.development cross-env NODE_ENV=development concurrently "vite build --watch" "vite preview --port 3001 --config vite.config.https.mjs"
scripts.serve:qa:https: npm run _check:https && env-cmd -f ./.env.qa cross-env NODE_ENV=qa npm run validate:env && env-cmd -f ./.env.qa cross-env NODE_ENV=qa concurrently "vite build --watch" "vite preview --port 3001 --config vite.config.https.mjs"
scripts.serve:prod:https: npm run _check:https && env-cmd -f ./.env.production cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run validate:env && env-cmd -f ./.env.production cross-env NODE_ENV=production concurrently "vite build --watch" "vite preview --port 3001 --config vite.config.https.mjs"
scripts._check:https: npx tsx -e "import{existsSync}from'fs';import{resolve}from'path';const d=resolve('cert');const k=resolve(d,'localhost+2-key.pem');const c=resolve(d,'localhost+2.pem');const k2=resolve(d,'key.pem');const c2=resolve(d,'cert.pem');if(!existsSync(k)||!existsSync(c))if(!existsSync(k2)||!existsSync(c2)){console.log('\n❌ HTTPS certificates not found!');console.log('\n🔧 Run: npm run setup:https');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.publish:s3:qa: env-cmd -f ./.env.qa cross-env NODE_ENV=qa npx tsx scripts/uploadToS3.ts
scripts.publish:s3:prod: env-cmd -f ./.env.production cross-env NODE_ENV=production npx tsx scripts/uploadToS3.ts
scripts.publish:oracle:qa: env-cmd -f ./.env.qa cross-env NODE_ENV=qa npx tsx scripts/uploadToOracle.ts
scripts.publish:oracle:prod: env-cmd -f ./.env.production cross-env NODE_ENV=production npx tsx scripts/uploadToOracle.ts
scripts.purge:bunny:qa: env-cmd -f ./.env.qa cross-env NODE_ENV=qa npx tsx scripts/purgeBunnyStandalone.ts
scripts.purge:bunny:prod: env-cmd -f ./.env.production cross-env NODE_ENV=production npx tsx scripts/purgeBunnyStandalone.ts
scripts.deploy:qa: npx env-cmd -f ./.env.qa cross-env NODE_ENV=qa npx tsx scripts/npmVersionManager.ts && npm run build:qa && npm run publish:oracle:qa
scripts.deploy:prod: npx env-cmd -f ./.env.production cross-env NODE_ENV=production npx tsx scripts/npmVersionManager.ts && npm run build:prod && npm run publish:oracle:prod
scripts.analyze: cross-env ANALYZE=true NODE_ENV=production npm run build:prod
scripts.analyze:sunburst: cross-env ANALYZE=true VISUALIZER_TEMPLATE=sunburst NODE_ENV=production npm run build:prod
scripts.analyze:network: cross-env ANALYZE=true VISUALIZER_TEMPLATE=network NODE_ENV=production npm run build:prod
scripts.analyze:list: cross-env ANALYZE=true VISUALIZER_TEMPLATE=list NODE_ENV=production npm run build:prod
scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm run build
